summary: Iteration 103 - Fallback Timeline Testing. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend /admin/universe-monitor page verified with Fallback Timeline panel showing event rows with all required fields: timestamp, trigger_metric, threshold_breach, exit_reason, cycle_snapshot. Fallback metrics displayed (fallback_active=false, fallback_healthy_streak=0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 103 verified fallback timeline functionality. Key findings: 1) Fallback trigger thresholds: latency>1500ms OR backlog>20 OR stale_rate>5%, 2) Fallback exit logic: latency<900ms AND backlog<8 AND stale_rate<2% for 3 consecutive cycles, 3) GET /api/admin/universe-monitor/fallback-events returns items with timestamp, trigger_metric, threshold_breach, exit_reason, cycle_snapshot, 4) Admin universe monitor summary includes fallback_active and fallback_healthy_streak fields, 5) POST /api/user/scanner/run returns scanner_perf with requested_selection_mode, effective_selection_mode, overload_fallback_applied, fallback_state, 6) Regression: /api/debug/effective-universe returns 198 spot and 302+ futures symbols.

fallback_trigger_thresholds.notes: latency>1500ms OR backlog>20 OR stale_rate>5% triggers fallback to top_volume mode

fallback_exit_logic.notes: latency<900ms AND backlog<8 AND stale_rate<2% for 3 consecutive cycles exits fallback

fallback_events_endpoint.notes: GET /api/admin/universe-monitor/fallback-events returns items array with required fields

fallback_event_fields.notes: Each event has: timestamp, trigger_metric, threshold_breach, exit_reason, cycle_snapshot

fallback_event_threshold_breach_structur.notes: threshold_breach contains: trigger_thresholds, exit_thresholds, current, breach, healthy_for_exit, required_consecutive_healthy_cycles

fallback_event_cycle_snapshot_structure.notes: cycle_snapshot contains: queue_backlog, cycle_latency_ms, stale_rate, symbols_evaluated, timestamp

scanner_run_fallback_state.notes: scanner_perf includes fallback_state with active and healthy_streak

admin_universe_monitor_page.title: UNIVERSE MONITOR - visible
admin_universe_monitor_page.metrics_grid: 12 metric cards present including fallback_active and fallback_healthy_streak
